caption: The drawing depicts a figurine set consisting of two main objects mounted on a rectangular base. On the left, there is a seated human figure with dark brown skin, wearing a yellow shirt, blue pants, and black shoes. The figure is facing slightly right and is holding a thin stick or whip in its right hand, extended towards a horse. The horse, positioned on the right side of the base, is brown with a black mane and tail, and is adorned with a comprehensive harness system featuring various straps and a brown covering over its back. Both figures are attached to a platform that is shaded in greenish-grey on top and reddish-brown on the sides, with some details suggesting a metallic or painted surface. The horse and human face each other, with the human in a seated position and the horse standing on all four legs. The drawing is signed "Sarkis Erganian" in red at the bottom right corner.
title: Cast Iron Mule Bank
